title: canonicalUrl rewrites every accepted subdomain host to bare zoom.us, and accepts the ungrounded /rec/play/ kind and subdomain hosts as ok:true with no verified flag, so a downstream consumer can fetch a URL never evidenced to resolve
evidence: parseZoomRecordingUrl('https://acme.zoom.us/rec/share/AbCdEfGh12345678') -> ok:true canonicalUrl 'https://zoom.us/rec/share/AbCdEfGh12345678'; 'https://acme.zoom.us/rec/play/AbCdEfGh12345678' -> canonical 'https://zoom.us/rec/play/AbCdEfGh12345678'. Manifest states the bare host serving every subdomain's recording is UNVERIFIED. The id is the token only, so tenants on different hosts with the same token string collapse (unlikely, but host is dropped from identity).
fix_direction: Keep the validated lower-cased host in canonicalUrl (loss-free; still re-parses to the same id); treat only the grounded /rec/share/ on zoom.us as verified and either refuse /rec/play/ and subdomains with a typed unverified-shape reason or return verified:false; manifest must state recordingId AND canonicalUrl are bearer secrets not to be logged or shown without redaction.
